component.name: WorkBuddy AI
component.summary: Full-scenario AI office agent workbench by the Tencent CodeBuddy team

description.p: WorkBuddy is Tencent's full-scenario AI office agent workbench from the CodeBuddy team: chat with agents, delegate coding/document/browser tasks, and orchestrate multi-agent workflows.
This Flatpak is an UNOFFICIAL native Linux build assembled from Tencent's official x86_64 distribution resources (Electron runtime). Not affiliated with or endorsed by Tencent.
